featured_reviews.name: ROHAN REDEKAR
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you want to eat authentic and affordable pav bhaji in a bustling city like Mumbai, Lenin Pav Bhaji is a must-try place. This place is famous for its bhaji made with Amul Maska and for its reasonable prices. Every customer who comes here feels the taste of the real Mumbai streets with the first bite.

The main identity of Lenin Pav Bhaji is their bhaji dipped in Amul butter. Fresh vegetables — potatoes, peas, tomatoes, bell peppers, and a wonderful blend of spices — are used while preparing the bhaji. The generous use of Amul Maska on it gives the bhaji a creamy, aromatic, and satisfying taste. The crispy pav roasted on a tava, melted butter on top, and a lemon wedge served with it — this experience attracts every customer again and again.

The prices here are another big feature.  The plain pav bhaji costs around ₹70–₹90, while the special Amul pav bhaji costs around ₹110–₹120. These prices are really affordable for such quality taste. This makes this place a good choice for students, workers, and families.

The service is fast, the staff is polite, and the place is always kept clean. Even in a crowded place, the taste and quality are maintained, which is the success of Lenin pav bhaji.

Overall, Lenin pav bhaji is the perfect blend of authentic Mumbai street food, the magic of Amul mask, and affordable pleasure. This place scores 10 out of 10 in all three aspects - taste, quality, and price.

customer_updates.text:

• Established in 1975 by a former Indian Army veteran, it has been serving Mumbaikars and travelers for decades.
• Known for its rich, buttery, and flavorful pav bhaji made in the traditional Mumbai style.
• The pav is perfectly toasted with butter and pairs wonderfully with the delicious bhaji.
• The place has a unique old-Mumbai charm and is an important part of the city's food heritage.
• Despite being a simple standing food stall, it attracts food lovers from across India.
• Quick service, authentic taste, and a nostalgic atmosphere make the experience memorable.
• A must-visit spot for anyone who wants to enjoy Mumbai's legendary pav bhaji and experience a piece of the city's culinary history.

Overall: Great taste, rich history, and a true Mumbai street-food experience. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Sonawane
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Cannon Pav Bhaji near CST and, unfortunately, the experience was quite disappointing. We tried several items Pav Bhaji, Sheera, Sabudana Khichdi and Lassi and to be frank, everything was absolutely tasteless. For a place that is always crowded and located in such a prime spot, I genuinely expected much better in terms of flavour and quality.

The Pav Bhaji lacked the rich, buttery taste and balanced spices that you normally find even at simple street side stalls across Mumbai. The Sheera was bland and lacked the aroma and sweetness that make it enjoyable. Sabudana Khichdi, which is usually comforting and flavourful, felt underwhelming as well. Even the Lassi didn’t have the freshness or thickness you would hope for.

It feels like the only advantage this place has is its central location right outside CST, which naturally attracts tourists and daily commuters. In contrast, some of the other nearby stalls actually serve tastier food at far more economical prices.

Overall, Cannon Pav Bhaji didn’t live up to its hype or its location. If you’re looking for flavourful, satisfying Mumbai street food, you’re better off exploring the smaller stalls around the area.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Cannon Pav Bhaji, situated opposite Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT) in Mumbai, has long been celebrated as a go-to spot for this iconic street food. Known for its rich, flavorful bhaji paired with buttery, toasted pav, it has attracted both locals and tourists seeking an authentic Mumbai culinary experience. ￼

Its a quite old place with its unchanged taste of food, especially their Pav-bhaji. This outlet was started by a retired military officer. Hence, the name "CANNON". Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre in Mumbai my grandfather used to take me to have pav bhaji 2000 to 2014. Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre is a renowned destination for street food enthusiasts, serving mouth-watering pav bhaji that has captured the hearts of many. This iconic eatery has earned a reputation for its delicious food, prompt service, and cozy ambiance.

Ambiance
The ambiance at Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre is warm and inviting, perfect for a quick bite or a casual meal with friends and family. The decor is minimal, but the vibrant atmosphere and aroma of freshly cooked food make up for it.

Menu and Offerings
Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre's menu is centered around its signature dish, pav bhaji, which is a flavorful mix of vegetables cooked in a rich tomato-based gravy, served with soft, buttery pav bread. Some popular items on the menu include-
- *Pav Bhaji*: The star of the show, made with a medley of vegetables and spices, served with pav bread.
- *Special Pav Bhaji*: A variation of the classic dish, made with extra butter and spices.

Quality and Taste
The quality and taste of Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre's offerings are exceptional. The pav bhaji is cooked to perfection, with a rich, buttery flavor that's hard to resist. Customers rave about the delicious food, and many have returned for years, making it a testament to the eatery's consistency.

Service
The service at Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre is prompt and efficient, ensuring that customers receive their orders quickly and without any hassle. The staff is friendly and courteous, adding to the overall positive experience.

Value for Money
Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre offers excellent value for money, with prices starting from around ₹120-₹200 per person for a meal. Given the quality and quantity of food, it's a steal.

Tips
- Visit Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre during off-peak hours to avoid crowds.
- Try the special pav bhaji for an extra-rich flavor experience.
- Pair your pav bhaji with a buttermilk, lassi or cold drink for a refreshing contrast.

Online Ordering and Delivery
For those who prefer the convenience of home delivery, Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre offers online ordering through platforms like Justdial and Zomato. This allows customers to enjoy their favorite dishes from the comfort of their own homes.

Overall Experience
Cannon Pav Bhaji Centre is a must-visit destination for anyone looking to experience the best of Mumbai's street food scene. With its delicious pav bhaji, prompt service, and excellent value for money, it's a culinary gem that will leave you wanting more.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Chaturvedi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Went to Foo Town for dinner with my mum and had a great experience. The moment we walked in, the ambience stood out straight away! the lighting, decor, and overall atmosphere were beautiful and made the place feel really special.

The drinks were amazing as well, and the staff were all incredibly sweet and welcoming throughout the evening. The only issue we had was with one dish we ordered that never arrived. We asked about it twice and were told they would check on it, but it still didn’t come, so we ended up ordering another plate of sushi while we waited.

Thankfully, the missing dish wasn’t added to our bill, so no complaints there. It was a small hiccup, and I’d just suggest being a bit more mindful with orders, but apart from that everything was lovely.

The food we did receive was great, the atmosphere was stunning, and overall it was a really enjoyable dining experience.

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Aman Bhonsle
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been coming here since I was a kid—long enough that I’m pretty sure my first real chicken tandoori happened right here. The menu has changed over the years, sure, but the place has stubbornly refused to lose its old-school charm. Portions? Still generous. This isn’t food that apologizes for itself.

The Chinese starters have absolutely nothing to do with China—and thank God for that. They’re loud, greasy, Indo-Chinese comfort bombs that slap hard. Pick any of the chicken gravies and you’re in a good place emotionally. I will say this: the kebabs feel a little smaller than they used to. Shrinkflation? Age? Betrayal? I don’t know. Still good. Just… noted.

Twenty-one years ago, when I was a broke college student and my parents would leave town—trusting me alone at home far more than they should have—I ordered from here like it was a civic duty. My friends from that era still remember how much food I could put away from this place. This is not health food. No one here is pretending otherwise. But it hits all the right buttons.

I ordered so often that before food apps, before algorithms, the guy answering the phone knew my order just by hearing my voice. Within an hour, like clockwork, the food would land at my parents’ place. I’d sit there demolishing it while binge-watching American TV, living my best irresponsible life.

Some of my old favorites are gone now, but the current menu holds its own. I’ve eaten here with my wife, with her family, across decades and phases of life. Parking is usually manageable. There’s a mosque nearby, Bombay Hospital around the corner, and the now-shuttered Liberty Cinema—where I watched half my childhood movies. The area isn’t glamorous. It doesn’t try to be. It’s old Mumbai, still breathing, still feeding people properly.

This place survives because it’s trusted. Because it’s consistent. Because people who know food still show up here quietly and eat without drama.

What’s instantly noticeable is who eats here.
Old-school locals, serious food people, and a steady stream of expats—especially Arab expats—who clearly didn’t wander in by accident.

Late at night, you’ll see many happy Muslim families settling in comfortably, sharing plates, unhurried, treating the place like an extension of home.

Go without hesitation.
Ask the manager what to order.

Then sit down and let them take care of you.

Every product reflects freshness, authenticity, and care. It is rare to find a place where quality remains so consistent over time. The prices are reasonable considering the premium quality offered, making it a great value for money.
